title: 2-Year Treasury Yield (DGS2)
summary: Daily 2-Year Treasury yield closed at 3.78% on April 16, 2026, up 2 basis points from the prior day's 3.76%. Recent observations show the yield ranging between 3.76% and 3.81% over the past week.
key_points: Yield range over recent observations: 3.76% to 3.81%
